thread:
Maya (Finance Ops): QuotaPilot sent a renewal that mixes commit + overage. Need quick eyes from procurement/eng/legal before we reply.
Sam (Procurement): Copy. Main asks: itemized SKUs, can commit be prepaid annually, migration credits, cancellation/termination windows.
Ravi (Platform): Usage snapshot: last 3mo avg = 520M tokens/mo, 95th = 780M. We need per-route attribution and a webhook example to validate ingestion.
Jamie (QuotaPilot Sales): Hi all 52 offering tiers: 250M=$1,500/mo, 750M=$3,600/mo, 1.25B=$5,500/mo. PAYG = $0.008/1k tokens. Migration credit: up to 18% of first-year committed spend applied monthly for 12 months on 12mo commits. Annual prepay gets extra 7% off. SLA: 99.9% for Enterprise.
Jamie (QuotaPilot Sales): Sample webhook payload:
POST /webhooks/usage
{ "customer_id":"rw-9876", "ts":"2025-12-03T14:12:01Z", "tokens":430, "route":"/v1/chat", "req":"req_abc123" }
Sam (Procurement): Please send a sample invoice (Net30) and SKU list (commit, overage, support, SLA add-on). Also confirm if overage can be charged at discounted rate when on active commit.
Jamie (QuotaPilot Sales): Will attach quote + invoice PDF. Overage discount: yes, 10% off PAYG when on active commit.
Priya (Legal): Need data retention policy for raw request bodies, DPA, subprocessors, and explicit non-auto-renew clause (30-day opt-out). Also any termination penalties.
Jamie (QuotaPilot Sales): Standard raw retention = 60 days; aggregated billing metrics retained 7 years. DPA available, SOC2 report on request. We can add 30-day non-auto-renew clause in enterprise addendum.
Maya (Finance Ops): If we move from PAYG to 750M commit, ballpark savings vs PAYG? Ravi can you validate token mapping to routes once webhook spec arrives.
Ravi (Platform): I'll validate once webhook/invoice arrive.
Sam (Procurement): Scheduling 30m sync with QuotaPilot sales for Tue 11am PT. Jamie confirm?
Jamie (QuotaPilot Sales): Confirmed. I'll upload SKU sheet, sample invoice, DPA, and webhook schema to the shared folder by EOD Friday.
Maya (Finance Ops): Thanks team 52 we'll review the formal quote and decide on prepay vs monthly commit after TCO.
